criterionTask.response: one or more context-free meanings or translations

productProbe.typedMeaning: optional exactly as in the default product interaction
productProbe.primaryOutcome: indicator that the first-stage action is known-claim
secondaryOutcomes: optional typed-meaning availability and adjudicated correctness when present

revealControl.reason: preserve the no-criterion-before-product control while capturing the actual first-stage response modality
revealControl.transportLimitation: the delayed reveal is a developmental instrumentation deviation after the primary first-stage response; this study does not estimate full adaptive-session behavior

primaryEstimand.formula: Pr(first-stage known-claim | criterion-before-product) - Pr(first-stage known-claim | product-before-criterion)
primaryEstimand.equivalenceRule: approved confidence interval lies wholly inside [-interferenceMargin, +interferenceMargin]

unblockRule: freeze all v1 and v2 actual-study decision fields and receive independent statistical/research/privacy approval before real developmental collection
